text.zh: 在伦敦东区的一所小学读书。
text.en: Attends a primary school in London's East End.

text.zh: 7 岁时他说长大后想当骑师。
text.en: At seven he says he wants to be a jockey when he grows up.

text.zh: 在伦敦东区长大。
text.en: Growing up in London's East End.

text.zh: 已从小学升入现代中学，明年四月将离校。
text.en: Has moved from elementary school to a secondary modern, and will leave school next April.

text.zh: 课余时间都泡在埃普索姆的 Tommy Gosling 赛马马房，离校后将在那里工作。
text.en: Spends all his free time at Tommy Gosling's racing stables in Epsom, where he will work after leaving school.

text.zh: 父亲替他联系了马房；父母一直希望他当骑师。
text.en: His father arranged the stable place for him; his parents had always wanted him to be a jockey.

text.zh: 在伦敦东区长大。
text.en: Growing up in London's East End.

text.zh: 一心想当骑师；若知道当不成，就离开赛马圈，去学开出租车。
text.en: Set on being a jockey; if he knew he couldn't make it, he would leave racing and learn the taxi trade.

text.zh: 15 岁离开东区的现代中学，现正备考伦敦出租车司机的“知识”考试。
text.en: Left his East End secondary modern school at 15; now studying for the taxi Knowledge.

text.zh: 骑摩托车跑路线备考“知识”，并在 Hackney Wick 赛狗场替赌客跑腿下注。
text.en: Learning the Knowledge on his motorbike and running bets for punters at Hackney Wick dog track.

text.zh: 没有女朋友；他说家人中最爱妈妈。
text.en: Has no girlfriend; of his close family, he says he loves his mum best.

text.zh: 住在伦敦东区，说自己在那里扎了根，不想离开。
text.en: Lives in London's East End, where he says he is firmly rooted and would not want to leave.

text.zh: 15 岁离校到埃普索姆当学徒骑师，只骑过三场比赛便放弃了。
text.en: Left school at 15 to be an apprentice jockey in Epsom, rode in only three races, then gave up racing.

text.zh: 他承认自己当骑师不够格，并说人生就是一场你死我活的竞争。
text.en: He accepts he simply wasn't good enough to be a jockey, and calls life one big rat race.

text.zh: 一边开出租车，一边上表演课。
text.en: Is taking acting lessons alongside his cab driving.

text.zh: 开着自己的伦敦出租车，并已做了六年电影临时演员。
text.en: Drives his own London cab and has worked as a film extra for six years.

text.zh: 与 Debbie 结婚，育有 Nicky 和 Jodie 两个孩子，第三胎预计三月出生。
text.en: Married to Debbie with two children, Nicky and Jodie; a third baby is due in March.

text.zh: 考取了“知识”执照，如 21 岁时所誓言，成了伦敦出租车司机。
text.en: Gained the Knowledge and became a London taxi driver, as he had vowed at 21.

text.zh: 他的人生哲学是永不停步：人生不等人，要趁早尽量多做。
text.en: His philosophy is never to keep still: life waits for nobody, so cram in as much as you can.

text.zh: 与 Debbie 合开一辆伦敦出租车，她跑白班、他跑夜班，并兼做临时演员。
text.en: Shares a London cab with Debbie, who drives days while he drives nights, and works as a film extra.

text.zh: 与 Debbie 结婚，有儿子 Nicky（13 岁）和女儿 Jodie、Perry。
text.en: Married to Debbie; they have a son, Nicky, 13, and two daughters, Jodie and Perry.

text.zh: 一家人住在伦敦北部。
text.en: The family lives in North London.

text.zh: 父母相继去世；Debbie 流产后又生下 Perry；与姻亲合伙开的酒吧也已放弃。
text.en: Both his parents died; Debbie lost a baby and later had Perry; a pub run in partnership with a brother-in-law was given up.

text.zh: 他说，人生就是要给孩子自己从未有过的机会。
text.en: He says life is about giving your kids the opportunities you never had.

text.zh: 仍是伦敦出租车司机，他跑夜班、Debbie 跑白班，并靠电视工作补贴收入。
text.en: Still a London cabbie, working nights while Debbie drives days, and earning extra from TV jobs.

text.zh: 与 Debbie 育有三个孩子；长子 Nicky 是家具抛光师，还和他同队踢球。
text.en: Married to Debbie with three children; eldest son Nicky is a French polisher and plays football alongside him.

text.zh: 1993 年离开东区，现住埃塞克斯郡伍德福德。
text.en: Lives in Woodford, Essex, having left the East End in 1993.

text.zh: 1993 年搬到伍德福德；Debbie 发现他出轨，婚姻险些破裂。
text.en: Moved to Woodford in 1993; Debbie found out about his infidelity and the marriage nearly ended.

text.zh: 他确信，两年的努力和决心就能让家里摆脱财务困境。
text.en: He is sure two years of hard work and determination will get them out of their financial hole.

text.zh: 他和 Debbie 仍开伦敦出租车，现改为租车，他还偶尔接电视工作。
text.en: He and Debbie still work as London cabbies, now hiring a cab, and he takes occasional TV jobs.

text.zh: 与 Debbie 育有三个子女，还有几个年幼的孙辈；他说自己亲手照看孙辈。
text.en: Married to Debbie with three children, Nicky, Jodie and Perry, and young grandchildren; he calls himself a hands-on granddad.

text.zh: 仍住伍德福德的家，并用二次抵押贷款在西班牙买了度假屋。
text.en: Keeps the family house in Woodford and has bought a holiday home in Spain with a second mortgage.

text.zh: 将房子二次抵押买下西班牙度假屋，打算在那里开体育酒吧；夫妻说如今很幸福。
text.en: Remortgaged the house to buy a holiday home in Spain, where he plans a sports bar; the couple say they are now happy.

text.zh: 他现在的梦想就是和家人一起健康快乐，他说自己已经做到了。
text.en: His dream now is simply to be happy and healthy with his family, which he says he already is.

text.zh: 仍是伦敦出租车司机；他说经济衰退后十辆车只抢两单生意。
text.en: Still a London cabbie; he says the recession has left ten cabs for every two jobs.

text.zh: 与 Debbie 结婚 32 年，育有三个孩子；外孙女 Toni 与他们同住。
text.en: Married to Debbie for 32 years, with three children; granddaughter Toni, Jodie's daughter, lives with them.

text.zh: 与几个子女同住伦敦的家，另在西班牙有第二套房。
text.en: Shares a London home with several of his children and also owns a second home in Spain.

text.zh: 经济衰退让他在西班牙的生意计划落空；儿子 Nicky 在父母资助下考取出租车执照。
text.en: The recession scuttled his business plans in Spain; son Nicky got his cab badge with his parents' funding.

text.zh: 他说子女和孙辈就是他的一切，自己非常幸运。
text.en: He says his children and grandchildren are his life and that he is very lucky.

text.zh: 仍开伦敦出租车，但因 Uber 收入少了约三分之一；仍接表演工作。
text.en: Still drives a London cab but has lost about a third of his income to Uber; he still takes acting work.

text.zh: 与 Debbie 育有三个孩子、六个孙辈；外孙女 Toni 由夫妻俩带大。
text.en: Married to Debbie with three children and six grandchildren; the couple brought up granddaughter Toni.

text.zh: 回到埃塞克斯郡，住在林间一个 50 岁以上人士的社区。
text.en: Back in Essex, living in an over-50s community surrounded by forest.

text.zh: 西班牙生意计划落空，卖房回国；患肺栓塞后幸存，需终身服用华法林。
text.en: Sold up in Spain and came home when his business plans collapsed; survived a pulmonary embolism and is on warfarin for life.

text.zh: 他说在西班牙创业的梦想已化为泡影，并希望自己仍在那里。
text.en: He says his dreams of a business in Spain went out the window, and he wishes he were still there.

text.zh: 伦敦出租车司机出身，70 岁时说自己半退休的生活很快乐。
text.en: A London cabbie, he says at 70 he is very happy in his semi-retirement.

text.zh: 他说自己和妻子已相伴 46 年。
text.en: He says he and his wife are still together after 46 years.

text.zh: 70 岁时，他是半退休的伦敦出租车司机，与妻子相伴 46 年；他称放弃赛马是一生最大的错误。
text.en: At 70 he is a semi-retired London cab driver, still with his wife after 46 years; he calls quitting horse racing his biggest mistake.
